description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Marche], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Holy abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [111% ATB 1]/[125% ATB 1] after using Holy abilities before/after triggering Weapon Skill while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Holy Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Holy 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Holy Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Quadracast Holy (Tactical)] to user if user has 50+% HP, grants [Stoneskin: 100%] to all allies if not

description.name: Holy Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Holy attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Holy 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Holy ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Holy Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Quadracast Holy (Tactical)
description.text: Holy abilities trigger 3 additional times, removed after triggering or if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Stoneskin: 100%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 100% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached
